During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] conducted a '''raid''' in the [[Corsin system/Legends|Corsin system]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster|Plooriods]].

==The raid==
Following the [[Disaster at Deepspace Besh|disaster]] at [[Tingel Deepspace Besh|Deepspace Besh]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] stepped up raids and military action in an effort to keep the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] off balance.<ref name="TEA" />

As part of this strategy, the Rebel Alliance launched several raids in the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster|Plooriods]], including one in the [[Corsin system/Legends|Corsin system]].<ref name="TEA" />

The raid in the Corsin system resulted in a victory for the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="TEA" />
